title: The Frost Factor's Fair Price
story: At the Glacier Fair, Rimewald the Frost Factor hoarded every wool blanket while twenty-four shivering travelers waited outside his ice stall. 'Blankets are 8.5 silver acorns each,' he sniffed, 'and I never discount.' Mr 6 tapped the stall's frozen sign: ANSWER MY SUM, TAKE 25% OFF — which Rimewald had carved long ago and hoped nobody would read.
question: If Mr 6 buys 24 blankets at 8.5 silver acorns each and earns the 25% discount, how many silver acorns does he pay in total?
solution: The discount is 25% of 204 = 51 silver acorns.
praise: Multiplying to get the full price was spot on — the one step left was taking the 25% off before you answered.
hint: Find the full price first, then remember 25% is the same as one quarter of that price.
victory: Mr 6 counted out 153 silver acorns, and Rimewald — out-read and out-rounded — frosted over with embarrassment and handed out hot cider too. Twenty-four travelers went home warm, wrapped like very happy parcels.
imagePrompt: A frost-bearded merchant spirit behind a stall carved from blue ice at a glacier fair, shivering travelers in line, while a small numeral-six knight with a blue cape points triumphantly at a frozen discount sign.
